description: Flat record-level metadata schema for high-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing of microbial communities from coastal sediment samples across locations, seasons, and environmental gradients.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for each sediment sample record.

study_site_name.descr: Name of the coastal location or sampling site.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

region.descr: Broader administrative or geographic region of the sampling site, if applicable.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; examples include spring, summer, autumn/fall, or winter.

sediment_depth_cm.descr: Depth of sediment sampled, measured in centimeters below the sediment surface.

water_temperature_c.descr: Ambient or overlying water temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius.

sediment_temperature_c.descr: Sediment temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius.

salinity_psu.descr: Salinity measured at sampling time, in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: pH of the sediment porewater, overlying water, or sediment extract, depending on measurement context.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration, in milligrams per liter, if measured.

tide_state.descr: Tidal state at the time of collection, if known; examples include high tide, low tide, rising, or falling.

sediment_type.descr: General sediment classification; examples include sandy, silty, clayey, or mixed.

sample_replicate.descr: Replicate identifier for samples collected at the same site and time.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used for this sample.

amplicon_target_region.descr: 16S rRNA gene region amplified; examples include V3-V4, V4, or V1-V3.

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; examples include Illumina MiSeq or NovaSeq.

library_layout.descr: Library read configuration; examples include single-end or paired-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for each sequencing read.

barcode_index_sequence.descr: Sample index or barcode sequence used to demultiplex the library, if applicable.

raw_sequence_file_path.descr: Path, accession, or filename for the raw sequencing data associated with this sample.

processing_pipeline.descr: Bioinformatic pipeline used for quality control and feature generation; examples include QIIME2 or DADA2.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic assignment; examples include SILVA, Greengenes, or RDP.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method used for taxonomy classification; examples include naive Bayes classifier, BLAST, or exact matching.

otu_asv_count.descr: Number of OTUs or ASVs detected in the sample after processing.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of high-quality sequence reads retained for the sample after filtering.

environmental_notes.descr: Free-text notes describing any additional environmental observations relevant to the sample.
